listings.title: Malvern, PA Estate | Online-Only Curated Consignment Sale
listings.description: Malvern, PA Estate | Online-Only Curated Consignment Sale This week's online-only curated estate sale features the contents of a stunning Malvern, Pennsylvania estate! We've gathered a beautiful selection of original artwork, antiques, collectibles, estate jewelry, and unique home décor, with a special emphasis on an exceptional collection of equestrian and fox hunting items. The consignor was a member of the prestigious Radnor Hunt and spent years collecting beautiful equestrian-themed artwork, fox hunting memorabilia, decorative accessories, and other distinctive pieces that reflect the rich traditions of Chester County's horse country. These wonderful finds, along with hundreds of other curated antiques and vintage treasures, will be added to our online store on Wednesday, October 21, at 8 PM Eastern Time. Shop from the comfort of your home without the crowds, lines, or hassle of a traditional estate sale! Complimentary local delivery is included with your purchase, and nationwide shipping is available. Visit ShopSBH.com to browse our collection and shop this week's newest arrivals. New items added every Wednesday at 8 PM! Sales by Helen | Serving the Main Line and Greater Philadelphia area since 1986.

listings.title: Fixed 2 Move is in New Hope
listings.description: Fixed 2 Move invites you to an outstanding estate sale in New Hope, PA, featuring a sophisticated selection of fine furniture, unique seating, and curated home decor. Highlights include statement accent seating such as French country style balloon canopy chairs upholstered in striking cowhide-pattern fabric and premium leather, a vintage Chesterfield-style sofa in gold damask with deep button tufting, and elegant accent tables featuring hand-painted details and marble tops on ornate wrought iron bases. The sale also includes high-end decorative textiles, featuring intricate beaded and metallic throw pillows, alongside a large muted sage green traditional area rug with detailed floral scrolling. We accept major credit cards as well as cash, Venmo and Cashapp. Join us in New Hope for this exceptional shopping event.
